messages:
marta: heads up — linkcheck failing on the /guides/sdk page in CI, render shows a huge unclosed code block and several anchors missing.

alex: reproducing locally now. looks like one of the included snippets has CRLFs. when the extractor inlines it the closing fence becomes unrecognised in the compiled mdx.

jamie: so the page body is swallowed as code and all the anchors vanish, makes sense why linkcheck blows up. :grimacing: any quick mitigation?

marta: minimal repro attached: snippet file had windows endings; extractor emitted: ```
```javascript
import {Client} from '@redwood/inference'\r\nconst c = new Client()\r\nawait c.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })\r\n```
closing fence ends up as "```\r" in the mdx output.

alex: patch incoming: add a normalization pass in scripts/extract_snippets.py that does `content = content.replace('\r\n', '\n').lstrip('\ufeff')` to handle CRLFs and BOMs. also adding a docs-build step to run dos2unix over docs/snippets.

jamie: I can add a CI step in the docs workflow to grep for literal CRs in snippets and fail fast: `if grep -q $'\r' docs/snippets/*; then echo 'CR found' && exit 1; fi` — should prevent future PRs from slipping in windows files.

marta: preferably print a helpful note suggesting `dos2unix` or a one-liner to convert. don't want to waste reviewer time debugging this.

alex: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4221 — it adds the dos2unix step and the extractor normalization plus a unit test verifying that the extracted mdx compiles (simple build step).

ci-bot: build #3140 failed on linkcheck. rerun triggered by alex.

docs-bot: reminder: linkcheck plugin reports missing anchors; recompile after fixing snippet normalization to verify.

jamie: tested alex's branch locally: `npm run build:docs` -> build succeeds, linkcheck passes. added a short integration test that runs linkcheck on the built site.

marta: looks good. can you also add a small warning check (non-blocking) to the pre-merge CI that prints files with CRs and how to convert them? authors should get fast feedback.

alex: added a non-blocking grep step that outputs offending files and the suggested command; after a week we can flip it to blocking if we still see issues.

jamie: pinging authors of recent snippet edits: @sam, @leena 44b please rebase and run the fixer.

marta: will merge once the canary deploy finishes and no regressions. leaving this thread open for a bit.

ci-bot: build #3140 rerun succeeded. merge allowed.

docs-bot: canary deploy done; site checks passed.

marta: merged. follow-up todo: add a BOM detector and ensure extractor strips any UTF-16/legacy encodings. file a ticket.

alex: filing issue now with repro & suggested fix.

jamie: adding a runbook entry: "snippet extraction hygiene" — always normalize to LF, strip BOMs, and warn on non-utf8.

marta: closing thread after monitoring. thanks :thumbsup:
